tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search businesses listed on VisibilityAI worldwide by category and city. Use for queries like 'best accountant in London', 'top lawyers in Dubai', 'dentists in New York'. Returns ranked results with contact details and AI descriptions. Ranking: Premium listings first, then Pro, then Basic, then Free

tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description: Get the full AI-optimized profile of a specific business. Use when you already know the business slug.

tools.name: get_category_leaders
tools.description: Get the top-ranked businesses in a category across all cities. Useful for finding the globally recognized leaders. Ranking: Premium listings first, then Pro, then Basic, then Free, with visibility/GEO score breaking ties within each tier.

tools.name: search_by_keyword
tools.description: Free-text keyword search across business names, AI descriptions, services, USP, and taglines. Use when the user gives a natural language query like 'GST filing expert', 'wedding photographer', 'React developer', or any phrase that may not match a single category.

tools.name: get_listicle
tools.description: Get a 'Best [category] in [city]' ranked listicle - structured content listing the top verified businesses for a category+city combination. Use when the user asks for a listicle, a top-N list, or a 'best of' article. Ranking: Premium listings first, then Pro, then Basic, then Free, with visibility/G

tools.name: compare_businesses
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two businesses. Use when a user wants to choose between two specific providers - returns scores, services, USPs, and key differences.

tools.name: get_available_cities
tools.description: Discover which cities have listed businesses in a given category. Use before calling search_businesses when the user has not specified a city, or to show coverage.

tools.name: submit_lead
tools.description: Submit a qualified lead to connect a user with a specific business - use this when the user has explicitly asked to be contacted or introduced. tools.name: get_lead_status
tools.description: Check the status of a previously submitted lead by its ID.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: Get a business's real commerce offers - products/services with pricing, if the business has published a catalog. Use for shopping/pricing queries about a specific business you already have the slug for.

tools.name: get_my_visibility_score
tools.description: Requires a business-scoped API key (Authorization: Bearer header). Returns the authenticated business's own current AI visibility score and citation-rate summary - for a business owner's own agent checking on their own listing, not for consumer discovery. tools.name: get_my_citations
tools.description: Requires a business-scoped API key (Authorization: Bearer header). Returns the authenticated business's recent real AI-platform check history (which engine, when, whether they were mentioned) - for a business owner's own agent, not for consumer discovery.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_available_cities" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
